_canonical: This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for CatOx facts that can change. The script reads these at runtime. SKILL.md and thresholds.md reference this file; they must not restate these values as independent literals. Change a value here and it changes everywhere.
setpoint_source: Intellishare ECO300 manufacturer spec, >98% VOC destruction efficiency; CatOx Engineering Brief (Drive doc 1pBwtOUc78e5ayvgTxMhiOJsPrO5L9ZPP681Oy3CApJg), Setpoint Supplement tab

manual_limits.source: Intellishare O&M Guide, ECO300 Electric Catox, N-24-2702A, Nov 2024 (Drive id 1qqTENyFo7jD_8s78MNC0i4n79xsgafET): §6.9 inlet 'above the alarm set-point of 900 degree F', outlet 'above the alarm set-point of 1100 degree F'; §4.3 ¶6b 'at no time shall the catalyst outlet temperature be permitted to exceed 1200°F. Normal continuous operating temperature shall not exceed 1150°F for more than 15 minutes during any 24 hours period.'

anomaly_checks._note: Working choices for the chat-report checks, not external specs. Trip = a fall from >=850°F of >=300°F within 30 min (the July 2026 hand count in thresholds.md). 200°F separates cold idle from running (July bands in thresholds.md). An offline stretch of <=3 readings with the unit above 200°F on both sides is flagged as a zero inside a run.
